description:
## Bug Fixes

### YouTube
- **Feed card layout:** the `Dynamic card colors` tint now covers the whole card below the thumbnail, the channel row included, instead of only the title area. It also stays on the channel row when a card is scrolled under the top bar.
- **Feed card layout:** Mixes are cards now, with the card background, the rounded corners and the same 12 dp gaps as the other cards, instead of blending into the page with a longer gap below.
- **Feed card layout:** hidden items, such as brand video ads and the placeholders of a loading feed, no longer add a gap of their own.
- **Built-in downloader:** the speed button of the offline player uses the Sharp speed icon, so it is the same size as the aspect button and the other player buttons.
- **Built-in downloader:** the codec, the bitrate and the format ID of the offline library cards use the normal secondary text color instead of green.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.19.0...v1.19.1)
